name: Builders, derived objects and tracked reads
scope: Allow project code to create new derived objects from raw and/or derived inputs.
Capture actual dependency-aware reads at field/resource granularity.
Support derived-of-derived chains and deterministic cycle detection.
Keep pure business functions separate from dependency infrastructure.

pre_execution_questions.question: Как project-specific code подключается в v0.1?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Нужен простой способ передать архив другому AI без глобальной plugin infrastructure.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Importable local `docengine_project` package configured in `docengine.toml`; Python entry-point plugins may be added later.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Importable local `docengine_project` package configured in `docengine.toml`; Python entry-point plugins may be added later.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.answer: Explicit registry as canonical mechanism with decorator convenience that writes into it.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.answer: No for tracked inputs: project builder may call pure helpers, but dependency-bearing reads must go through context/resolver; escape hatch must be explicit and unaudited.

emergent_questions.question: P2 introduces executable project code; where may the configured project package live?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Keeping project semantics separate from documentation-owned data prevents code/data ownership ambiguity and path escapes.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Require the configured package below project root, outside documentation root, with no symlinked entries.
emergent_questions.answer: Project package is confined to project root, must live outside docs, and all package-tree symlinks are rejected before import.
emergent_questions.decision: Project package is confined to project root, must live outside docs, and all package-tree symlinks are rejected before import.

emergent_questions.question: What exact runtime value is persisted/returned by a builder before P3 exists?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: P2 needs provenance/determinism without prematurely implementing P3 receipts/baselines/state.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Return a new immutable DerivedObject with deterministic in-memory BuildProvenance; do not persist dependency state yet.
emergent_questions.answer: Implemented immutable DerivedObject + direct tracked-read provenance and version/digests; persistent receipts remain P3.
emergent_questions.decision: Implemented immutable DerivedObject + direct tracked-read provenance and version/digests; persistent receipts remain P3.

emergent_questions.question: Should arbitrary Python builder outputs be accepted and coerced?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Silent coercion can make provenance hashes unstable or lose data semantics.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Accept only JSON-compatible object/array output with string keys and finite numbers; copy/freeze it into the derived object.
emergent_questions.answer: Non-JSON values, non-string keys and NaN/Infinity are rejected; mutable returned containers cannot mutate the derived result afterward.
emergent_questions.decision: Non-JSON values, non-string keys and NaN/Infinity are rejected; mutable returned containers cannot mutate the derived result afterward.

emergent_questions.question: Does implementing project-package loading and a new derived envelope add acceptance risks not present in the original P2 axis list?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Phase-local axis coverage must include risks actually introduced, not only the initial plan mapping.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Expand P2 mapping with DAX02, DAX03, DAX04 and DAX20.
emergent_questions.answer: P2 acceptance axes expanded to include documentation/code ownership, new contract/version/path risks and release/handoff integrity.
emergent_questions.decision: P2 acceptance axes expanded to include documentation/code ownership, new contract/version/path risks and release/handoff integrity.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Prevents false phase acceptance from incomplete axis mapping.

emergent_questions.question: Should `docengine rebuild` be wired in P2 merely because BuildEngine now exists?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: The CLI contract says rebuild mutates derived/runtime state, while P2 intentionally has no persisted receipts/baselines/materialization state.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Keep `rebuild` CLI explicitly not_implemented through P2; expose BuildEngine as the P2 programmatic runtime and wire CLI only when persistence/orchestration semantics exist.
emergent_questions.answer: `rebuild` remains an honest stub; docs explicitly distinguish the implemented P2 API from later CLI orchestration.
emergent_questions.decision: `rebuild` remains an honest stub; docs explicitly distinguish the implemented P2 API from later CLI orchestration.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Preserves DAX10/DAX20 boundaries and prevents premature P3/P5 behavior.

emergent_questions.question: Must every builder target have a documentation-owned derived descriptor?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Internal derived objects should not force JSON merely because they participate in computation, while materialized outputs still need documentation-owned output paths.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Internal-only derived targets may have no descriptor; materialized/documentation-owned derived targets use derived_descriptor, and every existing derived_descriptor must have a builder.
emergent_questions.answer: Implemented asymmetric rule: internal targets may be code-only; existing derived descriptors are never treated as raw fallback and must resolve to builders.
emergent_questions.decision: Allow internal code-only derived targets; require builder for every derived_descriptor and derived_descriptor kind for any builder target that also exists as a managed resource.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Corrects DAX02/DAX05 ownership and raw/derived separation.

emergent_questions.question: May file:// tracked reads address _structured, _dependency, or generated managed views?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Allowing storage-file reads bypasses canonical resource identity, schema and field-level tracking.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. In v0.1 file:// resolves only plain canonical Markdown; managed/derived content uses resource://.
emergent_questions.answer: ResourceCatalog now rejects file:// reads/versions unless the path is inventoried as plain canonical Markdown.
emergent_questions.decision: Restrict file:// to plain canonical Markdown in v0.1.

emergent_questions.question: Can callers bypass ref validation by constructing ResourceRef directly instead of parsing a string?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: A public identity object must remain canonical regardless of construction path.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Validate dataclass construction and reject non-canonical textual encodings rather than silently normalize them.
emergent_questions.answer: ResourceRef now validates direct construction and ResourceRef.parse requires exact canonical round-trip.
emergent_questions.decision: Canonical identity is enforced for both object construction and string parsing.

emergent_questions.question: If project_package is documented as dotted, must nested packages retain normal parent-relative import semantics?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Accepting company.builders but breaking from ..common makes the configuration contract false.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Yes. Load the dotted package hierarchy under an isolated private prefix while preserving normal relative imports.
emergent_questions.answer: Loader now executes package segments under a private prefix and supports parent-relative imports without adding project root as a public global package.
emergent_questions.decision: Support dotted packages as documented rather than narrowing the config contract.

emergent_questions.question: How is builder-code change represented in provenance before P3 invalidation exists?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Data dependencies can stay unchanged while formula/helper code changes; P3 needs a stable signal to mark derived targets build_required.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Content-address the project Python source bundle and include that revision in BuildProvenance; P3 compares stored/current revision.
emergent_questions.answer: Project extensions now compute a sha256 source revision over project-owned Python source and every derived provenance records builder_revision.
emergent_questions.decision: Builder source revision is part of deterministic provenance and will become a P3 invalidation input.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Closes a pre-P3 DAX05/DAX10 provenance gap.

emergent_questions.question: Is comparator selection builder-wide or dependency-specific?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: A single builder can depend on scalar, set/list and text inputs that require different P3 diff semantics.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Builder registration provides the default comparator; each ctx.read/get may override comparator for that dependency.
emergent_questions.answer: DependencyRead now records its own comparator; BuildContext read/get accept per-read override with builder comparator as default.
emergent_questions.decision: Comparator semantics are per dependency, with a builder-level default only.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Aligns P2 evidence with P3 receipt schema and DAX06/DAX07.

emergent_questions.question: Can audit_complete be interpreted as proof that arbitrary Python performed no hidden I/O?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Python project code is not sandboxed, so context tracking cannot observe code that intentionally bypasses it.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Keep cooperative project-code contract and expose machine-readable tracking_assurance=cooperative; audit_complete means no known gaps under that contract.
emergent_questions.answer: BuildProvenance now exposes tracking_assurance=cooperative and docs explicitly prohibit treating audit_complete as sandbox proof.
emergent_questions.decision: v0.1 uses cooperative trusted project code; stronger isolation may be evaluated later without overstating current assurance.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Clarifies DAX06 assurance without pretending Python sandboxing exists.

emergent_questions.question: Can ResourceCatalog expose a derived_descriptor as raw domain data before/without BuildEngine resolution?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: A descriptor owns output identity/metadata and must never masquerade as the derived result itself.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Inventory may expose the descriptor metadata, but get/version on its resource ref must require registered builder resolution.
emergent_questions.answer: ResourceCatalog now rejects raw get/version for derived_descriptor; BuildEngine resolves registered derived targets before consulting the raw store.
emergent_questions.decision: Descriptor data is metadata-only and never raw fallback truth.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Closes the remaining raw-fallback hole in Q2.E6 and DAX05.

emergent_questions.question: If a parent __init__.py imports the configured dotted child package, may the loader execute that child again?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Double execution breaks normal Python package semantics and can duplicate registration/import side effects.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Reuse the already-loaded expected child module after verifying its source path.
emergent_questions.answer: The loader reuses an already-loaded child under the private synthetic root and verifies that its __file__ matches the expected package __init__.py.
emergent_questions.decision: Dotted project packages preserve single-execution relative-import semantics.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Required for DAX10/DAX17 correctness of the documented dotted package contract.

emergent_questions.question: Should a whole structured-resource dependency version change when only JSON formatting or $docengine materialization metadata changes?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Builders consume domain data; metadata-only changes must not create false computational invalidation.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Version the canonical domain data value; keep physical source hash separate for source/inventory provenance.
emergent_questions.answer: ResourceCatalog.version(resource://whole) now hashes canonical domain data, while source_hash remains the physical file hash.
emergent_questions.decision: Whole structured-resource dependency identity is domain-data based in v0.1.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Prevents metadata/reformat-only false invalidation under DAX06/DAX10 and aligns P3 whole-resource baselines.

implementation_log.entry: implemented: Added domain-neutral BuilderRegistry, BuildContext, BuildEngine, immutable DerivedObject and deterministic BuildProvenance.
implemented: Added confined project-local package loading with register_builders(registry) and derived-descriptor ownership validation.
implemented: Added sample builder and unrelated product+tax fixture using the same runtime.
contract: Added DERIVED_OBJECT schema and P2 build-runtime documentation; project_package is now explicit config.
re-audit: corrected canonical ResourceRef construction/encoding and plain-Markdown-only file ref boundary.
re-audit: corrected internal-derived/descriptor symmetry and dotted package loading; added project source revision.
re-audit: provenance now exposes builder revision, cooperative tracking assurance and per-dependency comparators.
re-audit: ResourceCatalog now treats derived_descriptor as metadata-only and rejects raw get/version fallback.
re-audit: dotted project loader reuses a child imported by its parent instead of executing the child package twice.
re-audit: separated physical source_hash from canonical whole-resource dependency version so metadata/formatting-only edits do not invalidate domain computations.
re-audit: whole structured-resource versions now hash canonical domain data rather than physical JSON/envelope bytes.

findings: Materialized derived ownership remains in _structured; internal-only derived targets do not force JSON; existing derived descriptors require builders.
ResourceRef construction and text are canonical; derived/provenance envelope includes builder revision; runtime build identity advanced to dev5.
Project package remains confined/symlink-safe; file:// cannot read reserved structured/dependency storage or generated managed views; P2 persists no runtime state.
Raw inputs remain immutable; derived values are new/frozen; derived descriptors cannot silently fall back to raw data; builder source revision is traceable.
ResourceCatalog itself now rejects derived_descriptor raw get/version, closing descriptor-as-fake-truth fallback outside BuildEngine.
Exact tracked refs and per-dependency comparators are captured; file refs are plain-Markdown-only; cooperative tracking assurance is explicit and direct hidden Python I/O is outside the contract.
Whole-resource raw dependencies are versioned from canonical domain data rather than physical JSON/envelope bytes.
Whole-resource raw dependency versions ignore JSON formatting/$docengine metadata and track canonical domain data only.
Stable dependency ordering/digests plus builder source revision make unchanged code+inputs reproducible and make code changes observable for P3.
Dotted package child imported by parent executes once; loader reuses verified module instead of replaying import side effects.
Storage formatting/materialization-metadata-only edits no longer perturb whole-resource computational dependency versions.
Whole-resource raw dependency versions ignore JSON formatting/$docengine metadata and track canonical domain data only.
Cycles and builder failures are explainable; persistent repair/history is later.
Unrelated product/tax fixture uses same runtime; dotted project packages preserve relative-import semantics under isolated private prefix.
Dotted package support now covers parent-imports-child relative-import behavior without double execution.
Regression tests cover canonical refs, storage-boundary bypass, descriptor/builder symmetry, nested package imports, source revision and mixed comparators in addition to original P2 tests.
P2 re-audit corrected stale AI protocol/docs; active dev5 wheel/manifest/package are rebuilt after fixes.

acceptance_summary.notes: P2 remains accepted after independent re-audit and final correction of whole-resource version semantics. Confirmed defects were corrected; cooperative Python tracking is explicitly bounded rather than presented as sandbox proof. P3 must consume builder_revision and canonical dependency slices for invalidation.
